footer.aboutText: Cineguru is an independent Istanbul production studio creating commercials, event films and brand stories since 2017. It combines traditional filmmaking discipline with next-generation production technology and AI scale.
privacyParagraphs: Due to strict confidentiality and non-disclosure agreements (NDAs) with clients, not all produced projects or partner details are publicly displayed on the website. This commitment to corporate safety and compliance is a cornerstone of the production discipline at Cineguru Studio.
The website does not collect personal data, use advertising cookies, or record browser history. The digital experience is completely cookie-free and secure.

Briefs, project request files, and communication details shared via email or phone are used exclusively for evaluating and planning production within the studio and are never shared with third parties.
